column1: # Anatomical coxa muscles with moment-arm vectors over flybody's three coxa hinges (B4
column2: s10). Built by scripts/build_coxa_muscles.py from FlyMimic (arXiv 2509.06426; flygym asset) front-leg MTUs. Thorax frames aligned by Kabsch on six coxa origins (rotation 13.4 deg
column3: RMS residual 92 um); FlyMimic coxa posed to flybody's neutral coxa long axis (residual 0.0 deg; keyframe 26.2 deg). r_mm = torque on the hinge per uN of tension (uN*mm/uN)
column4: signed: L = 1 - sum_j r_j (q_j - q_ref_j) / L0; torque_j = r_j F. r_keyframe_mm: arms at FlyMimic's raw keyframe (sensitivity). L_norm_flymimic: FlyMimic's normalised length at the matched pose (information; the model uses L = 1 at flybody neutral). F0 uN
column5: L0 mm; shape as leg_muscles.csv. label: derived (lf) / guessed (rf mirror
